name: work-cycle
description: Run bounded ForgeSteward work cycles through mandatory stage subagents and merge eligible changes.

interface.shortDescription: Run complete work cycles through stage subagents.
interface.longDescription: Run up to five complete work cycles by default, delegating each stage to its own subagent, reviewing and merging eligible changes, and pausing only items still blocked after a third repair round.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-work-cycle to run complete work cycles through subagents and merge eligible changes.
